documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of The Bard Meeting To Be Held On November 3, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Deep Industries Limited reported robust financial and operational performance for FY26 and Q1 FY27, backed by consistent order inflows and a growing consolidated order book of 3,047 crore rupees as of June 30, 2026. Management highlighted favorable macroeconomic and policy tailwinds in India's energy sector, including upstream exploration incentives, the GOBARdhan CBG scheme, and the Samudra Manthan national offshore exploration scheme. The company is actively pursuing higher-capacity drilling rigs and expanding its international offshore footprint via Dolphin Offshore. Furthermore, the company maintained a healthy balance sheet with low leverage and improved operational metrics across its onshore and offshore service segments. Deep Industries Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 financial performance with 40% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 278.92 crores and a net profit of INR 89.14 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects to generate almost more than INR 150 crores of revenue from the production enhancement contract in FY28.
guidance.quote: And for FY28, we are quite bullish on getting almost more than INR150 crores of revenue from this particular contract.

guidance.claim: Management targets a profit after tax of almost INR 500 crores for FY28.
guidance.quote: No, on FY28, we are gunning for a PAT of almost INR 500 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects standalone revenue growth of around 18% to 20% in the current financial year with consolidated growth of more than 25%.
guidance.quote: So, on a stand-alone basis, we are not -- we are expecting growth of somewhere around 18% to 20% in this current financial year with a consolidated growth of more than 25%.

demand_outlook.claim: Global oil demand is projected to rebound sharply through FY 2027 driven primarily by Asian economies.
demand_outlook.quote: Driven primarily by Asian economy, global oil demand is projected to rebound sharply through FY 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Continued policy thrust on exploration acreage, gas infrastructure, and domestic production capabilities is supporting sustained demand for integrated oilfield services.
demand_outlook.quote: Continued policy thrust on expanding exploration acreage, strengthening gas infrastructure and enhancing domestic production capabilities is supporting sustained demand for integrated oilfield services.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is very bullish that the entire offshore segment will offer excellent opportunities for growth over the next 2 to 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: We are very bullish on the fact that the entire offshore segment would have an excellent opportunity for growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Dolphin Offshore's DP2 dynamically-positioned barge has commenced revenue generation.
capex_expansion.quote: The dynamically-positioned DP2 barge, owned by Beluga International DMCC, Dubai —a wholly-owned subsidiary of Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Ltd —has commenced revenue generation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to do a capex of closely INR 150 crores by March 2027 for the production enhancement contract.
capex_expansion.quote: We also plan to do a capex of closely INR150 crores by March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure is strictly committed only upon securing firm deployment contracts.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure is strictly committed only upon securing firm deployment contracts.

capex_expansion.claim: Initial estimates suggest capex for reviving Kandla manufacturing facilities would not be more than INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, it would not be more than INR10 crores, INR15 crores as our initial estimate suggests.

capex_expansion.claim: Management estimates a potential capex of around INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores in FY27 if higher capacity drilling rigs are awarded.
capex_expansion.quote: But yes, based on our broad estimates, we may do capex of around INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores in FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 44.24% for FY26.
The company posted an EBITDA of INR 131.8 crores in Q1 FY27 with an EBITDA margin of 43.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Operational efficiencies have helped us post 38.7% Y-o-Y growth in EBITDA to INR131.8 crores in FY21 -- in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA margin of 43.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated they have been maintaining EBITDA margins in the range of 43% to 45%.
margins_costs.quote: We have been maintaining EBITDA margins in the range of 43% to 45%, providing us a decent cash flow to strategize our future growth trajectory.

margins_costs.claim: The primary motive of acquiring Kandla was to improve operating margins by manufacturing hydrocarbon fluids in-house.
margins_costs.quote: So, on that part, we are working on it on reviving their manufacturing facilities. So, we are expecting probably later in this current financial year to start getting contribution from Kandla as well on improvement of our operating margin.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing critical chemicals in-house at Kandla is estimated to improve operating/EBITDA margins by 1.5%.
margins_costs.quote: So, our primary estimate suggests that we can improve on operating margin by 1.5% with the help of manufacturing this chemical in-house.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA in Q1 FY27 grew by 38.73% to Rs. 131.83 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA in Q1 FY 27 grew by 38.73% from Rs. 95.02 in Q1 FY 26 to Rs. 131.83 in Q1 FY 27

orders_capacity.claim: Deep owns more than 80 gas compressors.
orders_capacity.quote: Asset size: the Company owns more than 80 gas compressors

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns 6 drilling rigs and 14 workover rigs.
orders_capacity.quote: 6 Drilling Rigs 14 Workover Rigs Coring Services Air Drilling

orders_capacity.claim: Fleet utilization in the onshore drilling and workover rigs segment is 100% as on date.
orders_capacity.quote: Our fleet utilization is 100% in the segment as on date.

orders_capacity.claim: As on June 30, the company's order book stood at INR 3,047 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: As on June 30, our order book stood at INR3,047 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns a total of 20 onshore drilling and workover rigs, comprising 14 workover rigs and 6 drilling rigs.
orders_capacity.quote: We own total 20 numbers of onshore drilling rigs and workover rigs, of which 14 are workover rigs, the capacity ranging from 30 to 150 tons, and 6 drilling rigs with capacity of 1,000 horsepower.

orders_capacity.claim: The bidding pipeline for orders continuously hovers around INR 700 crores to INR 800 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: And the bidding pipeline would be continuously hovering around INR700 crores to INR800 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: From the loan given to Prabha Energy, the company has received back almost INR 86 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes. So, from the loan given to Prabha Energy, we have received back almost INR86 crores from them.

capital_allocation.claim: Management expects to clear and recover the entire loan given to Prabha Energy by the end of the second quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: And probably by end of second quarter, we are expecting to clear the entire loan repaid.

capital_allocation.claim: Management does not foresee any equity raise given strong balance sheet support and net-debt-free status.
capital_allocation.quote: And since we are having debt-free on a net debt basis, probably our balance sheet support us for taking some debt as well in case of new capex. So as of now, we are not foreseeing any equity raise.

risks_headwinds.claim: Incremental production at the Mori 5 well was delayed by 5 to 6 months due to an unfortunate incident.
risks_headwinds.quote: We had taken over the field in April 2025 and started with the baseline production. But due to an unfortunate incident at one of our wells at Mori 5, the incremental production was delayed by 5 to 6 months.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start contributing through incremental production from the PEC contract by October 2026.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to start contributing through incremental production by October 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to execute almost INR 800 crores of the order book over FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, I think you can consider almost INR800 crores kind of contracts would be executed over FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects incremental production from the PEC contract to start contributing from September end or October onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And the incremental production should start contributing from September end or October onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
